Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); if incomplete, block and return. Attest c1.

Re-run and observe green.

m2-guard.title: Write the doctrine-coverage guard (new test file)
m2-guard.imperative: RED: before authoring the guard's assertions, prove its scan basis by hand -- run the scan against the pre-declaration tree (git stash the m1 change or reason from evidence already captured) and confirm it reports commander-delegated as scanned-but-undeclared. GREEN: write tests/test_role_tier_coverage.py: scan skills/*/templates/*_HANDOFF.template.md for a 'model tier' field (role = filename stem before _HANDOFF), skills/*/SKILL.md for a role whose text names a ratified LAUNCH_ORDER as its frozen principal (role = that skill's own name: frontmatter), and specs/*.spine.toml stems -- union these, assert non-vacuous floors on every walk, and assert the union is a subset of ROLE_MODEL_TIERS['claude']. Include a fixture-based test proving the subset assertion can fail (mutates a local dict, not the real table).

postconditions.statement: TDD red: scan-vs-pre-declaration-state evidence captured showing commander-delegated as the gap -- manual attest

check.command: env -u SPINE_FILE -u SPINE_SESSION -u SPINE_PARENT -u CREW_SCRATCH_DIR python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_role_tier_coverage.py
